newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler -M3, import prices speak against rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler -M3, import prices speak against rate cut.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Tuesday that the development of M3 money supply and of German import prices speak against further cuts in German interest rates.

"I do not see the current development of the money supply and import prices as additional signs for further interest rate cuts," Zeitler, president of the Bavarian state central bank, told a news conference.

German import prices have been boosted recently by the depreciation of the mark on foreign exchanges and M3, which slowed to an annualised growth rate of 8.3 percent in March after 9.1 percent in February, remains above the Bundesbank's target corridor of 3.5 percent to 6.5 percent for this year.
